name: homeostatic iron regulator
pathways: positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction

function.text: HFE encodes hereditary hemochromatosis protein. Annotated molecular activities include transporter activator activity and beta-2-microglobulin binding. It participates in positive regulation of SMAD protein signal transduction and receptor-mediated endocytosis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hemochromatosis type 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
